description_en: Image Translation Plus is designed specifically for e-commerce images. It uses a Mixture of Experts (MOE) architecture and delivers superior translation accuracy for multiple minority languages compared to the Lite and Pro editions. Use it for the following 8 language pairs, with more to be supported in the future
description_zh: 图片翻译PLUS版产品专为电商图片设计，采用MOE架构，相比于图片翻译lite版和Pro版，在多个小语种的翻译准确性上表现更胜一筹，建议您在以下8个语向上进行使用，后续会拓展更多语向
name: ImageTranslationPlus

parameters.help_en: The source language. This parameter is required
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language. This parameter is required
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The URL of the original image. This parameter is required
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the product body. This parameter is optional. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译商品主体上文字，选填，默认false
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the image translation editor protocol. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用图翻编辑器协议，选填
parameters.name: use_image_editor

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand text on the product. This parameter is optional. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译品牌上文字，选填，默认false
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: glossary
